scope: Fixtures and expected results, including fixtures that are able to fail a check.
does: Give every fixture a payload or a non-empty expectFail list.
Keep a fixture that cannot fail out of the suite.
doesNot: Accept an empty fixture as conformance.
Treat a fixture that has no payload and no expectFail as a check.

claims.text: An empty fixture list fails, a missing file fails, and a fixture with neither payload.event_properties nor expectFail fails.
